nodes.title: Check question — Dust You Cannot See at a Building Site
nodes.why: One question on the idea just taught. A missed answer goes to a simpler re-teach step, then back here. Never scored against anyone.

check.q: The little vacuum hose slips off the model drill's shroud and a puff of dust appears. What do you do?
options: Stop the model drill first, then fix the hose.
check.why: When the hose comes off, the shroud stops catching dust.

reteach: Find the tools that catch the dust.
Put the dust test in order.
Stand behind the rope with the crew lead.
